name: Festival Of Trumpets
overview: The Festival of Trumpets, established by the LORD through Moses, is observed on the first day of the seventh month as a sacred assembly marked by the blowing of trumpets. This day is a sabbath and a holy convocation, signifying a solemn feast appointed by God for the children of Israel to gather without performing servile work. The trumpet blasts serve as a memorial and a call to worship, emphasizing the importance of reverence and communal recognition of God's appointed times.
